_finding: Coinbase Advanced Trade does NOT reject a duplicate client_order_id with an error. Re-submitting the same client_order_id (market_order_buy, same product) returns success=true with the ORIGINAL order_id and does not create a second order or move funds (idempotent dedupe). There is no error text, so _looks_like_duplicate can never fire on the real duplicate shape; the correct duplicate signal is success_response.order_id matching an order_id already recorded in the execution ledger for that client_order_id.
